analysis: paired event-level bootstrap on validation split
confidence_interval: 95% percentile bootstrap interval for candidate minus baseline
multiple_comparisons: Holm-adjusted descriptive bootstrap tail estimates across non-baseline methods separately for each metric. Interpret cautiously; these are not a replacement for a prespecified inferential test.
limitations: Bootstrap resamples recommendation events and assumes events are the analysis units; events from the same conversation may be dependent if multiple events share a conversation.
The CSV does not contain recommended top-10 movie IDs, so catalog coverage and item Gini cannot be bootstrapped from this file.
Validation results are for method selection and uncertainty analysis only; do not use these results as final held-out test performance.
A percentile interval crossing zero suggests the observed difference is uncertain under this bootstrap procedure; it does not prove equivalence.
